title: T3 Code skins gallery
subtitle: Community themes shared after T3 Code became fully customisable on 14 Nov 2026 (IST).

announcement.author: @theo
announcement.text: T3 Code now lets you fully customize your UI in app. Ask your agent to make changes and it will update on the fly

skins.name: Nyx
skins.author: Deepu
skins.description: A dark dithered night sky behind T3 Code. Pixel-art aurora and stars, frosted glass panels, and soft violet accents.

skins.name: Nebula
skins.author: itssotsot
skins.description: Deep purple and magenta, with slowly drifting nebula clouds behind the chat.

skins.name: Pixel-Koi Pond
skins.author: kanigaraa
skins.description: Koi swim behind the chat, and a small frog follows your cursor while you type.

skins.name: Rainy Window
skins.author: @BobzHolmes
skins.description: Switches from Light Mode with the lights off to Dark Mode with the lights on! Edited from Claude Code version.

skins.name: JetBrains Islands
skins.author: Blake Connally
skins.description: Jetbrains Rider Islands theme lookalike

skins.name: Solar Flare
skins.author: itssotsot
skins.description: Near-black with a molten orange accent, a warm glow rising behind the chat and a softly lit message box.

skins.name: Starry Ridge
skins.author: DeepExtrema
skins.description: A dotted night sky behind T3 Code. Stars sparkle faintly, a shooting star passes now and then, and unread threads breathe a soft plum glow. Source: github.com/DeepExtrema/t3code-starry-ridge

skins.name: Aurora Sky
skins.author: Yash Mahajan
skins.description: quiet night-sky theme for T3 Code Nightly: LED-dot aurora, a readable chat, and Nightly's sidebar art restored. Default colors, dark and light.

skins.name: Neon Arcade
skins.author: itssotsot
skins.description: Retro synthwave: an animated sunset with a moving neon grid, glowing header and frosted-glass replies.

skins.name: Biscuit
skins.author: itssotsot
skins.description: Warm browns and caramel, with a pixel pet above the message box that naps until you start typing.

skins.name: Fjord
skins.author: itssotsot
skins.description: Deep slate blue with an icy cyan accent and a slow northern-lights glow drifting across the top of the chat.

skins.name: Matrix
skins.author: itssotsot
skins.description: Green-on-black with falling code rain behind the chat and glowing terminal text.

skins.name: Pixel Pal
skins.author: itssotsot
skins.description: A retro pixel palette with a little pixel buddy above the message box that wakes up when you type.

skins.name: Firefly Dream
skins.author: Dev Gupta
skins.description: Night meadow with glowing fireflies and a frosted-glass composer.

skins.name: Orange Space
skins.author: vertopolkaLF
skins.description: dark theme in orange color with nice subtle animation as background.

skins.name: Rosé
skins.author: itssotsot
skins.description: Blush pink and deep wine, with a soft petal glow in the corner and rounded, airy message bubbles.

skins.name: Midnight Mono
skins.author: itssotsot
skins.description: Pure black and white. No colour, no effects, just high contrast for long sessions.

skins.name: Ember Blade
skins.author: Unknown
skins.description: Dark ember forge: drifting sparks, a flying ember comet and hot-orange glints on hover.

skins.name: Paper Lantern
skins.author: itssotsot
skins.description: Warm paper tones with a vermilion accent, faint ruled lines behind the chat and serif headings in replies.

skins.name: Sandstone
skins.author: itssotsot
skins.description: Desert beige and terracotta by day, warm clay by night, with a faint sunlit gradient behind the chat.

skins.name: Blueprint
skins.author: itssotsot
skins.description: Drafting-table blue with a white grid behind the chat, dashed message outlines and monospace headings.

skins.name: Lagoon
skins.author: itssotsot
skins.description: Deep teal water with a coral accent and slow light waves rolling across the bottom of the chat.

skins.name: Arctic
skins.author: itssotsot
skins.description: Cool white and clear blue, with a frosted-glass message box and a faint icy glow in the corner.

skins.name: Vitesse Nyx Emerald
skins.author: Liam
skins.description: A pixel-art aurora and starfield behind frosted charcoal panels, with a softly glowing crystal above the composer. Warm off-white text, fine scanlines, and restrained green highlights keep long coding sessions calm and readable.

skins.name: Little Guardian
skins.author: Wesley Smits
skins.description: A true black theme with warm orange accents and an animated little guardian keeping you company while you code.

skins.name: Matcha
skins.author: itssotsot
skins.description: Soft green tea tones in light and dark, with a gentle leafy glow at the bottom of the chat.

skins.name: Panda Syntax
skins.author: MatiasCiccone
skins.description: Port of Panda Syntax by Siamak Mokhtari (© 2016, MIT), with a darker canvas after Panda Calibrated by Mahir Hami Abrar (© 2026, MIT). Mint, pink and peach on charcoal.

skins.name: Drafting Table
skins.author: Unknown
skins.description: An ink-black drafting table. A fine 16px dot grid sits under warm paper-white text. Amber is the only signal colour, with a rare steel-blue accent. Your messages and the selected thread carry crop-mark corners, and the composer glows amber while you type.

skins.name: Visual Studio 2017
skins.author: Blake Connally (@blakeconnall)
skins.description: Remake of the Visual Studio 2017 Design. This includes all search and model selectors.

skins.name: Tritium
skins.author: Blake Connally (@blakeconnall)
skins.description: Tritium - Focused on a sleek, greenish dark theme with high readability for night time work.

skins.name: Gotham Noir
skins.author: Fayeque Peerzade
skins.description: This is an art deco style batman theme, also the batman moves when you type!

skins.name: Spider
skins.author: bzhsf
skins.description: spidey inspired

skins.name: Stillwater
skins.author: Kayzel
skins.description: Gruvbox-warm text on deep charcoal with a calm teal accent, glass cards, and a gradient header and scrollbar. Dark and light modes.

skins.name: Minimalist color edges
skins.author: rgrvlsk
skins.description: The sidebar does not need to be a hard-to-read mess. Status icons and labels are removed to leave a single bar on the row's edge. Its shape says what the thread needs: full height waits on you, short has a result to read, dashed is running or held. Hover brings the label back.

skins.name: Vercel
skins.author: Hüsam 🥑
skins.description: Pure black with Geist-style grays, white primary buttons and blue focus accents. A faint 64px grid fades in from the top, and surfaces use crisp 1px borders.

skins.name: Telemetry
skins.author: xayot.dmg
skins.description: Mission-control HUD for T3 Code. Teal signal on near-black, monospace chrome, dotted grid canvas, HUD corner brackets on cards and composer, CRT-style scanlines, // headings, teal active-thread rail. Dark only; full borders/fonts need T3 Code 0.1.10+.

skins.name: Orng Dither
skins.author: Khushal
skins.description: capy like dither orng theme

skins.name: Dither Live — Dither
skins.author: Marve10s
skins.description: A T3 Code theme whose dotted gradient background changes every 20 minutes when the repo's installer is running. This file is the Dither variant.

skins.name: Dither Live — Streaks
skins.author: Marve10s
skins.description: Streaks variant of Dither Live, a rotating dotted-gradient series.

skins.description: Flutes variant of Dither Live, a rotating dotted-gradient series.

skins.name: GrokNight
skins.author: MistanKh
skins.description: GrokNight palette for T3 Code (colours only, no custom CSS in the published file).

skins.name: Aurora Azul
skins.author: marcosotomac
skins.description: Personal T3 Code theme from a four-skin set (Aurora Azul, Medianoche, Nebulosa, Vía Láctea).

skins.name: Medianoche
skins.author: marcosotomac
skins.description: Personal T3 Code theme from a four-skin set.

skins.description: Personal T3 Code theme from a four-skin set.

skins.name: Vía Láctea
skins.author: marcosotomac
skins.description: Personal T3 Code theme from a four-skin set.

skins.name: Claude Desktop
skins.author: KevinXC5
skins.description: Claude Desktop-inspired theme: warm charcoal and parchment palettes, Anthropic Serif prose, terracotta accents, and a 6-tier flowing-laser reasoning selector. Dark and light.

skins.name: Tool Flow
skins.author: haozhanghz / @haozhangzh
skins.description: Whack-a-mole for T3 Code: the chat background becomes a pixel-art meadow. A mole pops up for every tool call and is whacked when the call ends. The whole game is theme CSS.

skins.name: Stargazer
skins.author: wellbrained
skins.description: A night-sky theme for T3 Code: deep blue gradient, pixel stars and star signs that draw themselves beside your chat.

skins.name: Deep Field
skins.author: @beardwhocodes
skins.description: Keeps the default T3 Code palette and adds an animated flight through a solar system behind the open thread. Warp streaks show while the thread works.

skins.name: Deep Field (pixel-art)
skins.author: StivenKN
skins.description: An animated pixel-art space theme for T3 Code, published as a standalone repo the same weekend.

skins.name: YoRHa
skins.author: mths-mcfs
skins.description: A NieR: Automata inspired theme for T3 Code, with light and dark variants.

skins.name: Catppuccin Space Night
skins.author: PeytonWDYM
skins.description: Catppuccin space night theme for T3 Code: navy sky, drifting pastel stars, Latte in light mode.

skins.name: Habamax
skins.author: mark-vella
skins.description: Habamax (dark) and Xamabah (light) for T3 Code, based on the Vim colorschemes by Maxim Kim.

skins.name: Pixel Quest
skins.author: Jonathon-Sherrouse
skins.description: An animated JRPG pixel-art night theme for T3 Code. (17 GitHub stars as of 16 Nov 2026.)

skins.name: Bookshelf Calm
skins.author: vatana7
skins.description: A low-glare, book-style light theme for T3 Code. Palette only (no custom CSS).

skins.name: Bookshelf Paper
skins.author: vatana7
skins.description: A low-glare, book-style light theme for T3 Code. Palette only (no custom CSS).

skins.name: Pixel-Koi Pond Light
skins.author: kanigaraa
skins.description: Light-mode companion to Pixel-Koi Pond. The dark version is also on t3skins.dev. Koi swim behind the chat; a frog follows the cursor.

skins.name: Orbit
skins.author: Dave93 / @YulDavr
skins.description: Deep space with a star field and a rocket-orange accent in dark; a mission-control flight document with orbit rings in light. Part of a five-theme set posted on X.

skins.name: Canopy
skins.author: Dave93 / @YulDavr
skins.description: Morning meadow with patches of sun in light; night forest with fireflies and a lime accent in dark.

skins.name: Blueprint (Dave93)
skins.author: Dave93 / @YulDavr
skins.description: Drafting vellum and blue ink in light; cyanotype blue, chalk text, pencil-yellow accent and a grid in dark. Distinct from the t3skins.dev skin also named Blueprint.

skins.name: Sage Paper
skins.author: Dave93 / @YulDavr
skins.description: Warm paper with a deep sage accent in light; green-black, bone text and a pale sage accent in dark.

skins.name: Pixel Quest (Dave93)
skins.author: Dave93 / @YulDavr
skins.description: 8-bit overworld with gold dialog boxes in light; a night dungeon with navy dialog boxes and a gold accent in dark. Built on the Sweetie 16 palette by GrafxKid. Distinct from Jonathon-Sherrouse's animated JRPG Pixel Quest.

skins.name: Verdigris
skins.author: mr-karan
skins.description: A calm colour theme in two flavours, Limestone and Slate: weathered stone and patinated copper. The T3 Code port lives at ports/t3code/verdigris.json and includes light plus a dark variant.

skins.name: Market ticker (untitled)
skins.author: @nitesh_btc
skins.description: An X-shared T3 Code theme that shows live prices for Nasdaq, S&P 500 and Bitcoin and tells the author whether to keep working or retire. No public JSON file was found; preview is from the author's video.

images.alt: Market ticker theme screenshot from X

skins.name: Flipped usage + gradient (untitled)
skins.author: @Libes66
skins.description: Borrowed a gradient idea from @itssotsot and flipped the usage-limits display from 'left' to 'used'. The post says a theme link is below, but only screenshots were attached; no public JSON was found.

skins.name: Pixel WIP (untitled)
skins.author: @zwb44
skins.description: A work-in-progress pixel T3 Code theme shared as a screenshot. The author noted that X compression makes the pixel work look odd. No public JSON was found.

skins.name: Quoted skins preview (untitled)
skins.author: @yachtyyachty
skins.description: Screenshots posted while quoting Theo's customisation announcement: 'The upcoming T3 code skins features is FIRE.' No theme file was attached, so this may be a skin the author was already running rather than a new shareable file.
